Legacy source filenames in comments are provenance only; these active paths consume the listed cleaned workbooks.

issues.description: All named author-prepared H&M source families remain unverified for current user-side access, exact fields, identifiers, sheets and full construction history. NDA/nonsharing statements and catalog misses do not establish an access barrier.

The current driver invokes rebuild_icoc.do before rebuild_step.do even though rebuild_icoc.do reads step.dta and rebuild_step.do creates that exact path. Statically verified inputs and working-directory conventions support swapping those two calls in a separate working copy.

The supplied merge requires step2020.dta and step2021.dta, but the complete supplied code-source set contains no producer for these exact outputs. The similarly named Excel workbooks are used by program_enrollment.do, not produced as these .dta files; intended access and source/schema/history need clarification.

Official pages identify candidate World Bank exchange-rate, IMF CPI and FRED GDPDEF products, but exact fields, country/year coverage, series construction, revisions and in-code file formats remain unverified.
Six invoked Stata commands were not found by successful metadata checks on the checked paths; add-on availability/version and user adopath setup remain preparation items.
The successful R metadata query did not find the ten named packages in active library paths. User-side package setup and version checks remain necessary.
